cloud-panel-not-allowed: The Cloud Panel is only for the SuperAdmin, at the Cloud Panel Domain.
cloud-settings-desc: With WeKan in Weddy, the Cloud Panel serves many WeKan domains from one server, each with its own data. At the Cloud Panel Domain, the SuperAdmin manages the domains and CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: With a CloudFlare API key, a domain whose zone is in your CloudFlare account gets a proxied DNS record and a CloudFlare Origin certificate. Other domains get a Let's Encrypt certificate. The key is saved on the server and is never shown again.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: No CloudFlare API key is saved: every domain gets a Let's Encrypt certificate.
cloudflare-api-key-set: A CloudFlare API key is saved.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Other columns to import as text custom fields:
csv-mapping-description: Choose the column of the file that holds each card field. The choices were made from the column names; change any that are wrong, and choose (not in the file) for a field the file does not have.
csv-mapping-list-missing: The file has no column for the list. Choose one above, or type the name of the one list every card goes into.
csv-mapping-list-required: Type the name of the list every card goes into, or choose the column that holds the list.
csv-mapping-title-required: Choose the column that holds the card titles.
